response.overview: Reclusive book editor and true-crime podcaster Lili lives an isolated, meticulously controlled life in a remote cabin. Her routine is disrupted when Liam, a desperate stranger, arrives claiming that his missing girlfriend's last known location leads directly to her home. As Lili agrees to help him search the surrounding property, strange inconsistencies begin to surface. What initially appears to be a missing-person investigation soon forces Lili to confront the possibility that her own memories, perceptions, and carefully ordered reality may not be what they seem.
response.tagline: The absence of sound is still a sound.
response.title: When The Radio Goes Silent
